Creates one or more tags in a single request. Each tag in the request is processed independently, so some tags may succeed while others fail. The response contains a per-item result for every tag in the request, each marked with `success: true` or `success: false`.

For each tag, provide a `name` and `displayName`. Optionally include `parentId` to nest the tag under an existing parent, and `properties` to attach metadata such as `description`. Tags without a `parentId` are created as top-level t

Search for tags within an account. Use this to browse the tag taxonomy, find tags by name, or list tags filtered by status.

- **`query`** — Filters tags by name or display name. Searching for a parent tag also returns all of its descendants. When omitted or empty, all tags are returned.
- **`status`** — Filters tags by status (`ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `DEPRECATED`, `REJECTED`, `PENDING`). Defaults to `ACTIVE`. Set to `PENDING` to list newly discovered tag candidates awaiting review.
- **`limit`**
Retrieves the full definition of a single tag by its ID. The response includes the tag's name, display name, status, parent reference, and description.

Partially updates an existing tag using JSON Patch-style operations. Supported paths are `/name`, `/displayName`, `/status`, and `/description`.

Common use cases include renaming a tag, deactivating it, updating its description, or approving / rejecting a pending tag candidate (set status to `ACTIVE` to approve, `REJECTED` to reject).

params.name: tagId
params.description: Unique identifier for the tag to delete

items.docs: Permanently deletes a tag and all of its child tags. Any assets that were tagged with the deleted tag will have that tag association removed.
